name: Kagurazaka Hitomi
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c37087]Reika's[/url] younger sister. She's never allowed out of the mansion and because her only experience with men are as a prostitute she fears most of them. She can't take care of herself and is completely reliant on others for support.

[spoiler]She wants to run away from the mansion but was always afraid of men in the outside world. Because [url=https://vndb.org/c37087]Kyoichi[/url] is kind and gentle she hopes he'll run away with her. She is punished when they are caught.[/spoiler]
